title: Calhoun Makes his Offer

nodes.speaker: Calhoun
nodes.text: Found me, did ya? Took ya long enough.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Found me, did ya? Took ya long enough.

nodes.speaker: Calhoun
nodes.text: Look, soft-shoeing around won't help, it'll just piss me off. How much?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, soft-shoeing around won't help, it'll just piss me off. How much?

nodes.speaker: Calhoun
nodes.text: Give me strength... I am a loan shark. You are here for a loan. So say how much you wanna borrow or get out of my water.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Give me strength... I am a loan shark. You are here for a loan. So say how much you wanna borrow or get out of my water.

nodes.speaker: Calhoun
nodes.text: Don't waste time do you? Straight in with the demands. No niceties, no “nice to see you Mr Calhoun, how’s the fishing today, Mr Calhoun?”

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't waste time do you? Straight in with the demands. No niceties, no “nice to see you Mr Calhoun, how’s the fishing today, Mr Calhoun?”

nodes.speaker: Calhoun
nodes.text: Shit.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Shit.

nodes.speaker: Calhoun
nodes.text: You think I like fishing here? Dredging up freak eels and mutant lobsters? You ever tried to gut a fish with hands instead of fins?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think I like fishing here? Dredging up freak eels and mutant lobsters? You ever tried to gut a fish with hands instead of fins?

nodes.speaker: Calhoun
nodes.text: 'cos the act of angling is the only good thing in this stinking dunghill of a place and I'll be damned if I let them take it away from me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: 'cos the act of angling is the only good thing in this stinking dunghill of a place and I'll be damned if I let them take it away from me.

nodes.speaker: Calhoun
nodes.text: The Carp Diem. My old club. Mine, before those chum-buckets threw me out. Banned me from fishing any of the good spots in the Docks. Me! I was Barracuda Buddy three years in a row! I was the Prince of Perch!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Carp Diem. My old club. Mine, before those chum-buckets threw me out. Banned me from fishing any of the good spots in the Docks. Me! I was Barracuda Buddy three years in a row! I was the Prince of Perch!

nodes.speaker: Calhoun
nodes.text: Jealousy. They said I broke the fisherman's code. Never lie about your catch.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Jealousy. They said I broke the fisherman's code. Never lie about your catch.

nodes.speaker: Calhoun
nodes.text: Look, when I say I caught the Macrogillean, I'm telling CORA's honest truth.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, when I say I caught the Macrogillean, I'm telling CORA's honest truth.

nodes.speaker: Calhoun
nodes.text: Nice to know where your interests lie.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nice to know where your interests lie.

nodes.speaker: Calhoun
nodes.text: Macrogillean. The Baron of the Bay. The biggest fish ever seen in these parts. Some say he's over a thousand years old, scales so scarred and barnacled they look like microchips.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Macrogillean. The Baron of the Bay. The biggest fish ever seen in these parts. Some say he's over a thousand years old, scales so scarred and barnacled they look like microchips.

nodes.speaker: Calhoun
nodes.text: That fish let me catch him. Looked me right in the eye then spat my lure back at me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That fish let me catch him. Looked me right in the eye then spat my lure back at me.

nodes.speaker: Calhoun
nodes.text: You don't know who you're dealing with, do you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You don't know who you're dealing with, do you?

nodes.speaker: Calhoun
nodes.text: You know, not many people ask me about terms. What are you, some kinda Corpo grass?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know, not many people ask me about terms. What are you, some kinda Corpo grass?

nodes.speaker: Calhoun
nodes.text: Yeah well, you ain’t the only one to take tea with the bastards. Alright, terms. I only got one policy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah well, you ain’t the only one to take tea with the bastards. Alright, terms. I only got one policy.

nodes.speaker: Calhoun
nodes.text: Alright, alright. Terms. I only got one policy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, alright. Terms. I only got one policy.

nodes.speaker: Calhoun
nodes.text: I call it “limbs for Lims”. I loan you some Lims. You pay them back again or you can forget ever coming crying to me again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I call it “limbs for Lims”. I loan you some Lims. You pay them back again or you can forget ever coming crying to me again.

nodes.speaker: Calhoun
nodes.text: ‘S about the shape of it, yeah. So, you want these Lims?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ‘S about the shape of it, yeah. So, you want these Lims?

nodes.speaker: Calhoun
nodes.text: You keep telling yourself that, sweetheart. Well, you know where I am.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You keep telling yourself that, sweetheart. Well, you know where I am.

nodes.speaker: Calhoun
nodes.text: Done. Remember you got to pay it back. If you don't, you can expect a visit from my boys. Savvy?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Done. Remember you got to pay it back. If you don't, you can expect a visit from my boys. Savvy?

nodes.speaker: Calhoun
nodes.text: Eh, I can tell you don't give a shit. But I'll give you some credit for faking it. Maybe we can do some business.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Eh, I can tell you don't give a shit. But I'll give you some credit for faking it. Maybe we can do some business.

nodes.speaker: Calhoun
nodes.text: Cora, this is like getting blood from a stone. What you bothering me for, then? You're scaring the fish.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Cora, this is like getting blood from a stone. What you bothering me for, then? You're scaring the fish.

nodes.speaker: Calhoun
nodes.text: Then kindly fuck off. Before this scintillating conversation makes me swoon.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then kindly fuck off. Before this scintillating conversation makes me swoon.

nodes.speaker: Calhoun
nodes.text: For someone like you? 5000 Lims is my limit. I'll take a 20% interest.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: For someone like you? 5000 Lims is my limit. I'll take a 20% interest.

nodes.speaker: Calhoun
nodes.text: Aye. Pretty decent, don't you think?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Aye. Pretty decent, don't you think?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you Calhoun?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you Calhoun?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Who are you, exactly?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who are you, exactly?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't want to borrow anything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't want to borrow anything.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't want to borrow anything.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't want to borrow anything.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How much can you lend me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How much can you lend me?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How much can you lend me?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How much can you lend me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How’s the fishing today, Mr Calhoun?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How’s the fishing today, Mr Calhoun?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How’s the fishing today, Mr Calhoun?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How’s the fishing today, Mr Calhoun?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe you should try fishing in another spot?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe you should try fishing in another spot?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe you should try fishing in another spot?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe you should try fishing in another spot?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So why don't you move somewhere better?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So why don't you move somewhere better?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So why don't you move somewhere better?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So why don't you move somewhere better?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You mentioned money...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You mentioned money...?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Who's "they"?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who's "they"?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why did they throw you out?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why did they throw you out?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why did they throw you out?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why did they throw you out?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You mentioned money...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You mentioned money...?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And did you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And did you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So how much can you give me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So how much can you give me?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So how much can you give me?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So how much can you give me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I believe you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I believe you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The Macro...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Macro...?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And you caught him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you caught him?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wow.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wow.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like bullshit to me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like bullshit to me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are the terms?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are the terms?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fuck no.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fuck no.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I have my contacts.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have my contacts.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Which is?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Which is?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Transparency is the key to good customer relations.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Transparency is the key to good customer relations.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Transparency is the key to good customer relations.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Transparency is the key to good customer relations.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You’re preying on people’s desperation.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You’re preying on people’s desperation.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Lend me the cash.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Lend me the cash.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Deal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Deal.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I apologize.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I apologize.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Never mind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Never mind.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How IS the fishing here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How IS the fishing here?
